item.description: Technobrain announced today Bokukan 5, the next installment of its long-running ATC Simulator series, I Am an Air Traffic Controller. In the meanwhile, the latest iteration of Airport Hero, the console version of Bokukan 4, titled Airport Hero Centrair All Stars, was released today for Nintendo Switch.
